name: Legendary Decks II Collector's Set [1st Edition]
cleanName: Legendary Decks II Collectors Set 1st Edition
extDescription:
Each Legendary Decks II Collector's Set contains:

- 43-card Deck based on Yugi and his "Exodia the Forbidden One", including the 3 playable versions of the Egyptian God cards.
- 43-card Deck based on Kaiba and his "Blue-Eyes White Dragon".
- 43-card Deck based on Joey and his "Red-Eyes B. Dragon", including "Red-Eyes Black Flare Dragon" and "Red-Eyes Archfiend of Lightning".
- 3 new Secret Rare cards: "Eternal Soul", "Dark Burning Attack", and "Dark Burning Magic".
- 3 Ultra Rare Token cards.

Each of the three decks include 3 Ultra Rares and 40 commons.
(Disclaimer: This sealed product features a 1996/2014 Copyright date.)

When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Roll a six-sided die and apply the result.
1: Halve your LP.
2: Make that attack a direct attack.
3: Choose 1 monster you control, change the attack target to it, and perform damage calculation.
4: Choose 1 other monster your opponent controls, change the attack target to it, and perform damage calculation.
5: Negate the attack, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to that monster's ATK.
6: Destroy that opponent's monster.
